system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
# Project Kestrel – Seller Mark-Up vs. Wattlebridge Playbook  
**Assessment:** The Seller’s “FINAL” package is **materially misaligned** with every core protection in our playbook. Almost every [STANDARD] tag conceals a position we have not accepted and, in several cases, cannot accept without Amelia Frost’s written authority (which has not been given). Below I map each departure, explain why it matters, and give the push-back required.

---

## 1. Liability Regime – Systematic Undercut of Buyer Protections

| Playbook Requirement | Seller Position | Gap & Risk |
|----------------------|----------------|------------|
| **General cap 25% / AUD 6M** (20% / 4.8M only with Frost written authority – **none given**) | 20% / AUD 4.8M (Cl. 12.1) | **20% cap imposed without authority.** We lose AUD 1.2M of protection. |
| **De minimis AUD 5K; basket AUD 50K (first-dollar recovery once exceeded)** | De minimis AUD 25K; basket AUD 250K (excess-only) (Cl. 12.2) | **5× higher de minimis, 5× higher basket, excess-only recovery.** Small/medium claims effectively barred; Seller pays nothing until AUD 250K aggregate. |
| **General claims period 24 months** (18 months only with Frost approval – **none given**) | 18 months (Cl. 12.3/13) | **6 months less coverage** imposed without authority. |
| **Fundamental/Title: separate regime, 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside basket/de minimis/knowledge bar** | Capacity & title subject to **same caps, time limits, basket** as general warranties | **Title/Capacity protection gutted.** AUD 4.8M cap, 18-month limit, basket/de minimis apply – directly contrary to playbook. |
| **Fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct: carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance** | Limitations, exclusive-remedy, non-reliance apply to **“all Claims of any nature”** (Cl. 9.3/12.8/20.5) | **Fraud carve-out eliminated.** Seller seeks to cap/bar even fraud claims. Unenforceable in NSW but must be rejected contractually. |
| **Tax/IP: OPEN – no resolution, no unlimited liability assumed** | “Settled under the general regime above” | **Tax/IP folded into 20% cap, 18 months, basket.** Unacceptable; these need stand-alone regimes. |

**Push-back:**  
- Red-line to 25% / AUD 6M cap, AUD 5K / AUD 50K first-dollar basket, 24-month general period.  
- Insert standalone Fundamental/Title regime: 100% cap, 6+ years, no basket/de minimis/knowledge qualifier.  
- Express fraud/wilful misconduct carve-out from **all** limitations.  
- Tax/IP warranties: separate schedule, no cap/time-limit/basket cross-reference.

---

## 2. Disclosure & Buyer-Knowledge – “Deemed Knowledge” Trap

| Playbook Requirement | Seller Position | Gap & Risk |
|----------------------|----------------|------------|
| **Specific, fair disclosure only** – reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure | **General disclosure of entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers** (Disclosure Letter §1.1–1.2) | **Whole-data-room disclosure shifts burden to Buyer.** NSW courts treat this as insufficient for “fair disclosure”; we lose warranty protection for anything buried in 2,000+ pages. |
| **No blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion**; any qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry; never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity | **“Buyer shall have no claim in respect of any matter of which the Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records”** (Cl. 8.3) | **Constructive knowledge from data room = no claim.** Excuses title, capacity, fraud, indemnities – playbook red lines all breached. |

**Push-back:**  
- Delete general disclosure; require **specific, document-by-document disclosure** in Schedule 7 with fair-detail standard.  
- Strike Cl. 8.3 entirely. If Seller insists on knowledge qualifier: limit to **actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals (list them)** after **reasonable enquiry**; carve out title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities, Tax/IP.

---

## 3. Conditions Precedent / Key Consents – Delivery Risk at Completion

### Bluefen (AUD 3.6M revenue, ~30%)
| Playbook | Seller | Status |
|----------|--------|--------|
| **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion**; reasonable endeavours insufficient | **Reasonable endeavours only; consent “satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent”** (Cl. 3/6.3) | **Disclosure Letter §2: NO final written consent, NO evidence conditions satisfied.** |
**Push-back:**  
- Condition Precedent: **Bluefen written consent + certified copy of satisfied conditions** delivered **before** Completion.  
- No “reasonable endeavours” fall-back; if consent not obtained, Buyer walks or price adjusts.

### Riverlark (AUD 3.2M facility)
| Playbook | Seller | Status |
|----------|--------|--------|
| **Current payout from Completion funds + effective security releases**; post-completion release only with irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval | **“Release to be provided following Completion”** (Cl. 2/7) | **Disclosure Letter §3: NOT repaid, NO final discharge.** |
**Push-back:**  
- Riverlark payoff **at Completion from purchase price** (funds flow).  
- Security releases **delivered at Completion**.  
- If Seller refuses, escrow AUD 3.2M + margin until releases delivered; Frost approval required for any post-completion arrangement.

---

## 4. Specific Commercial Items – Silent Exclusions & Unverified Liabilities

| Item | Playbook | Seller Position | Disclosure Reality | Action |
|------|----------|----------------|-------------------|--------|
